stripping_discount_curve.method: Recomputed price and yield RMSE from per-bond result CSVs; compared with summary metrics.

shrinking_term_structure.method: Recomputed RMSE and uncentered R2 from bond prediction CSVs. Independently solved the four-coefficient primal ridge problem with augmented least squares and compared its predictions with authors' dual-space estimator.

sharpe_ratio_inference.method: Reviewed original f3 source AST, runner extraction, numeric-example constants and independent K=1 formula. Original simulation body and 5x100x4, T=60, 10000-path grid retained; Ray decorator removed and explicit seed added.

additional_independent_iid_gaussian_fini.method: For genuinely iid Normal returns and author ddof=0 standard deviation, the finite-sample SR estimator equals noncentral-t(59,sqrt(60)*SR)/sqrt(59). Compared as a reference benchmark because the author gaussian generator uses an empirical marginal transform.

reporting_boundaries: Stripping and Shrinking are 2026 publications with 2022 initial working-paper drafts. Do not present them as first written in 2026.
Stripping reproduces the two-date author example and supplementary sensitivity, not all historical benchmark tables or confidence intervals. Formula mapping uses the March 2023 author draft.
Shrinking reproduces the two-date core example. Cross-sectional leave-one-bond-out errors do not measure future-return forecasting or verify full-sample time-series risk premia.
Sharpe simulation reproduces the complete f3 main simulation grid of Exhibit 2, not the earlier T=24 severe-only block or all standard-deviation plots in the original notebook.

Sharpe generator applies Gaussian AR(1) copula ranks to empirical mixture marginals. Its rho is a generator parameter; transformed returns do not obey exactly the AR(1) innovation moment restrictions of the approximate closed form.
Sharpe source commit is February 2026; SSRN indicates latest revised paper March 25, 2026. Figure-by-figure equivalence to that paper was not verified.
PSR equals 1 minus a one-sided p-value in this author implementation. It is not a posterior probability that a strategy is effective. FDR quantities depend on specified priors and model power.
2013 KR-4 uncentered in-sample R2 is approximately 0.9663, whereas 1986 is approximately 0.5706; report each date separately.
